rename.resolution: Resolved 2026-10-27 (phase-515 P8): issue 2015 shipped upstream's free `rclcpp_action::create_server` at upstream's path, so the name agrees and the `blocked-needs-decision` it carried was stale. Both spellings stay: the free function (hosted) and the member `Node::create_action_server` (every build, the freestanding path).

why:
RE-VERDICTED 2026-10-27 (phase-515 P8), rename -> divergence/adopt-bounded, as its sibling `cpp:create_client` was. ENVELOPE (stated in `create_server.hpp`): HOSTED only -- the callbacks are `std::function`s and each goal handle a heap object, so a freestanding build refuses the call (`NROS_RCLCPP_REFUSE_ACTION_GOAL_HANDLE`) and uses the member factory; upstream's trailing options / callback-group arguments are not taken. issue 2015 (2026-10-24) -- LANDED. `rclcpp_action::create_server<A>(...)` exists at upstream's path (`rclcpp_action/create_server.hpp`, reached from `rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp` and `rclcpp_action/rclcpp_action.hpp`) in upstream's two shapes -- the four `node_interfaces` handles (`Node::get_node_*_interface`) and a node -- taking upstream's three goal-handle callbacks and returning `Server<A>::SharedPtr` (`rclcpp::Owned<Server<A>>`, the server by value). HOSTED only: the callbacks are `std::function`s and each goal handle a heap object; a freestanding build refuses the call (`NROS_RCLCPP_REFUSE_ACTION_GOAL_HANDLE`) and keeps the method `Node::create_action_server` + `set_*_callback_with_ctx`. Upstream's trailing options / callback-group arguments are not taken. Measured on the stock ros2/examples ports: the server example went from 77 edited lines to 6.

EARLIER (phase-488): measured that the free spelling alone would save no line while the handle shapes cost the rewrite, so it was not added. Both landed together here.

the free-function factory; ours is the method `nros::Node::create_action_server` plus `ActionServer::set_goal_callback` / `set_cancel_callback`. RE-VERDICTED 2026-09-04 (phase-417), declined -> rename: the capability is present under another spelling, so `declined` -- ROS 2 has it and we deliberately do not -- was never the right word, and the identical shape one entity over is already verdict `rename` at the service stage's `cpp:create_client`. What a porting user rewrites is in `cpp:Node::create_action_server`.

phase-488 (2026-10-21), measured on the stock ros2/examples ports in `packages/api/nros-cpp/tests/compile/rclcpp-examples/` (edit counts in its `edits.json`). MEASURED, decision still open: a free `rclcpp_action::create_server` / `create_client` would save NO line in the stock action examples, because the call they make takes the four `node_interfaces` plus `std::bind`-ed goal-handle callbacks, and the handle-free callback shapes (`cpp:Node::create_action_server`) are what costs the rewrite (79 and 87 edited lines). Adding the free spelling is therefore not a porting reducer and was not done; `<rclcpp_action/rclcpp_action.hpp>` WAS added (an umbrella the stock files include), which saved one line in each.
